assignment_model.common_rule: concrete reusable practice moves to common layer when fit_count > common_threshold_philosophers
assignment_model.personal_rule: select top minimum_personal_patterns slots by deterministic score per philosopher

defect_taxonomy.name: Semantic drift
defect_taxonomy.description: A name, rule or interface keeps the old spelling but changes meaning.

defect_taxonomy.name: Invalid state
defect_taxonomy.description: The code permits a domain state the role principle forbids.

defect_taxonomy.name: Concurrency conflict
defect_taxonomy.description: Two agents or workers claim the same mutable surface.

defect_taxonomy.name: Partial distributed failure
defect_taxonomy.description: One side effect lands while the matching state/event does not.

defect_taxonomy.name: Authorization ambiguity
defect_taxonomy.description: Authority, permission or prohibition is inferred instead of proven.

defect_taxonomy.name: Evidence gap
defect_taxonomy.description: The agent cannot cite code, test, trace or source evidence for a claim.

defect_taxonomy.name: False green
defect_taxonomy.description: A check reports success without covering the relevant behavior.

defect_taxonomy.name: Substitution failure
defect_taxonomy.description: Replacement preserves shape but not semantics.

defect_taxonomy.name: Data lineage loss
defect_taxonomy.description: A value loses origin, identity or transformation history.

defect_taxonomy.name: Perception failure
defect_taxonomy.description: The UI is technically present but not usable, visible or accessible.

defect_taxonomy.name: Policy contradiction
defect_taxonomy.description: Two rules can require incompatible actions.

defect_taxonomy.name: Runtime drift
defect_taxonomy.description: The deployed runtime no longer corresponds to the trusted repository state.

defect_taxonomy.name: RAG hallucination
defect_taxonomy.description: The agent applies doctrine without exact retrieved grounding.

defect_taxonomy.name: Aesthetic drift
defect_taxonomy.description: Visual language (color, type, symmetry, spacing) fails to trace to the declared design system, or diverges across screens generated under the same design-system id.

common_patterns.name: Design by Contract
common_patterns.technique: Assertions and pre/postconditions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches invalid state before it leaks across module boundaries.

common_patterns.name: Type-Driven Design
common_patterns.technique: Strong domain types and impossible-state encoding
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Makes illegal states unrepresentable at compile time where the stack allows it.

common_patterns.name: Property-Based Testing
common_patterns.technique: Generated counterexamples over invariant space
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds edge cases human examples usually miss.

common_patterns.name: Model-Based Testing
common_patterns.technique: Executable reference model for behavior
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Detects implementation drift against a simpler specification.

common_patterns.name: Mutation Testing
common_patterns.technique: Tests must fail when behavior is deliberately damaged
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents false confidence from weak assertions.

common_patterns.name: Static Analysis Gate
common_patterns.technique: Linters, type checks, SAST and schema checks in CI
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Moves defect discovery from runtime into coding time.

common_patterns.name: Exhaustive Case Analysis
common_patterns.technique: Closed enums, sealed types and total switches
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops unhandled states from silently reaching production.

common_patterns.name: Immutability by Default
common_patterns.technique: Immutable values except at explicit boundaries
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces hidden mutation, race conditions and spooky action at a distance.

common_patterns.name: Pure Core, Imperative Shell
common_patterns.technique: Pure decision logic wrapped by IO adapters
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps business behavior deterministic and easy to test.

common_patterns.name: Boundary Validation
common_patterns.technique: Validate all external input at the edge
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents polluted data from entering trusted internals.

common_patterns.name: Schema and Contract Validation
common_patterns.technique: OpenAPI, JSON Schema, AsyncAPI or equivalent
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Turns interface agreements into machine-checkable facts.

common_patterns.name: Consumer-Driven Contract Tests
common_patterns.technique: Provider behavior checked against consumer expectations
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops backend/frontend and service-to-service drift.

common_patterns.name: Semantic Versioning
common_patterns.technique: Public behavior changes only through explicit version rules
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents accidental breaking changes.

common_patterns.name: Backward Compatibility Window
common_patterns.technique: Deprecated behavior remains available for a planned interval
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets clients migrate without emergency coordination.

common_patterns.name: Idempotency Key
common_patterns.technique: Repeatable commands use stable operation identity
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents duplicate writes after retry or network uncertainty.

common_patterns.name: Optimistic Concurrency Control
common_patterns.technique: Version or status guard on state transitions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Blocks lost updates and read-then-save races.

common_patterns.name: Deterministic State Machine
common_patterns.technique: Explicit states and transition table
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents ambiguous lifecycle behavior.

common_patterns.name: Transactional Outbox
common_patterns.technique: Persist state change and event publication atomically
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Avoids split-brain between database and broker.

common_patterns.name: Saga with Compensating Actions
common_patterns.technique: Long workflow split into reversible steps
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Contains partial failure in distributed processes.

common_patterns.name: Circuit Breaker
common_patterns.technique: Stop calling unhealthy dependencies temporarily
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents cascading outages.

common_patterns.name: Bulkhead Isolation
common_patterns.technique: Separate resource pools for separate failure domains
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops one overloaded path from sinking the whole system.

common_patterns.name: Retry with Exponential Backoff and Jitter
common_patterns.technique: Bounded retry for transient faults
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces thundering herd and retry storms.

common_patterns.name: Rate Limiting and Backpressure
common_patterns.technique: Control inflow before queues become unbounded
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Protects latency, memory and external APIs.

common_patterns.name: Timeout Budgeting
common_patterns.technique: Every remote call has a bounded time contract
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Avoids stuck threads and zombie workflows.

common_patterns.name: Observability and Traceability
common_patterns.technique: Logs, metrics, spans and correlation IDs
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Turns suspicion into inspectable evidence.

common_patterns.name: Structured Error Taxonomy
common_patterns.technique: Errors include class, cause, retryability and safe action
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents ambiguous recovery behavior.

common_patterns.name: Audit Trail
common_patterns.technique: Security and business-critical decisions are recorded
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Makes accountability and rollback analysis possible.

common_patterns.name: Least Privilege
common_patterns.technique: Grant only the minimum required authority
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Limits blast radius after bugs or compromise.

common_patterns.name: Zero Trust Verification
common_patterns.technique: No caller, token or payload is trusted by default
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops confused-deputy and spoofing defects.

common_patterns.name: Secrets Isolation
common_patterns.technique: Secrets never enter source, logs or client bundles
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents credential leaks.

common_patterns.name: Input Canonicalization
common_patterns.technique: Normalize before validation, comparison or authorization
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents bypass through alternate representations.

common_patterns.name: Safe Output Encoding
common_patterns.technique: Encode per target context
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents injection through UI, SQL, shell, logs or URLs.

common_patterns.name: Accessibility by Default
common_patterns.technique: WCAG, keyboard flow and touch target checks
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents unusable interfaces from passing as complete.

common_patterns.name: Golden Master Regression
common_patterns.technique: Preserve known observable behavior during risky change
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches accidental regressions in legacy surfaces.

common_patterns.name: Snapshot with Semantic Assertions
common_patterns.technique: Snapshots are paired with behavior assertions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents brittle visual/text snapshots from hiding real defects.

common_patterns.name: Test Data Builder
common_patterns.technique: Named fixtures built through domain factories
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces fragile test setup and accidental invalid data.

common_patterns.name: Reproducible Seed Injection
common_patterns.technique: Randomness and time are injectable in tests
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Removes flakes from nondeterministic logic.

common_patterns.name: Containerized Toolchain Contract
common_patterns.technique: Build/test commands run in pinned containers
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents PATH, JDK, Node and native binding drift.

common_patterns.name: In-Memory Test Datasource
common_patterns.technique: Tests isolate database state from local files
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Avoids stale file DB corruption and cross-run contamination.

common_patterns.name: Migration Serialization
common_patterns.technique: Schema changes pass through one ordered lane
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents competing migrations and Flyway collisions.

common_patterns.name: Migration Rollback Plan
common_patterns.technique: Every migration has a tested recovery story
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces irreversible production failures.

common_patterns.name: Feature Flag Isolation
common_patterns.technique: Incomplete work is hidden behind explicit capability switches
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets parallel branches land without exposing half-built behavior.

common_patterns.name: Canary Release
common_patterns.technique: Expose change to a small monitored population first
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Detects production-only failures before full rollout.

common_patterns.name: Fast Rollback
common_patterns.technique: Rollback is practiced and bounded by time
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps recovery from becoming improvisation.

common_patterns.name: Small Vertical PR
common_patterns.technique: One coherent behavior slice per PR
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Shrinks review surface and conflict probability.

common_patterns.name: Merge Queue Gate
common_patterns.technique: Rebuild and retest on current main before merge
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops green-but-stale PRs from breaking main.

common_patterns.name: Single Writer Ownership
common_patterns.technique: Each shared surface has a declared owner
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents parallel agents from editing the same contract blindly.

common_patterns.name: CODEOWNERS and Review Routing
common_patterns.technique: Ownership is enforced by repository rules
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Ensures the right role sees the risky change.

common_patterns.name: Generated Artifact Authority
common_patterns.technique: Generated files are changed only through the generator
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents manual drift and regeneration conflicts.

common_patterns.name: Append-Only Extension Point
common_patterns.technique: Prefer new files/registrations over editing shared cores
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces merge conflicts in parallel work.

common_patterns.name: No Shared Constants Drift
common_patterns.technique: Enums and constants have one owner and compatibility tests
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops semantic divergence behind identical names.

common_patterns.name: Route Ownership Registry
common_patterns.technique: Each endpoint has one owning controller or handler
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents duplicate-route runtime failures.

common_patterns.name: Endpoint Collision Scan
common_patterns.technique: CI checks that no two handlers claim the same method/path
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches Spring/FastAPI/Express route conflicts before boot.

common_patterns.name: Semantic Conflict Test
common_patterns.technique: After text merge, run affected contract and behavior tests
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches meaning conflicts that Git cannot see.

common_patterns.name: Conflict Forecast in PR
common_patterns.technique: PR declares touched paths, owners and integration points
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets reviewers spot collisions before code lands.

common_patterns.name: Conflict Resolution Evidence
common_patterns.technique: Manual conflict resolution must add or run targeted evidence
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents guessed merges from entering main.

common_patterns.name: No-Op Supersession
common_patterns.technique: Superseded PRs are converted to tested no-op merges or closed
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Clears stale work without reintroducing old code.

common_patterns.name: Stale Claim Self-Healing
common_patterns.technique: Stuck automation claims are released with evidence
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps autonomous queues moving.

common_patterns.name: CI Status Reconciliation
common_patterns.technique: System reconciles GitHub state with internal task state
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents already-merged work from staying blocked.

common_patterns.name: RAG Source-Grounded Retrieval
common_patterns.technique: Agents cite exact source chunks before applying doctrine
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents philosophical slogans from becoming hallucinated rules.

common_patterns.name: Hoare Triple Review
common_patterns.technique: State precondition, command and postcondition before touching critical code
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents code that is locally plausible but globally unproved.

common_patterns.name: Temporal Specification
common_patterns.technique: Describe safety and liveness properties for workflows
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches impossible lifecycle promises and stuck-state defects early.

common_patterns.name: Model Checking
common_patterns.technique: Explore finite state spaces with tools such as TLA+, Alloy or equivalent
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds interleavings and corner states missed by example tests.

common_patterns.name: State-Space Reduction
common_patterns.technique: Collapse irrelevant states before verification
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps formal checks tractable without losing the defect class under review.

common_patterns.name: Algebraic Data Types
common_patterns.technique: Represent alternatives as tagged sums and products
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents invalid combinations from being representable.

common_patterns.name: Refinement Types
common_patterns.technique: Attach predicates to values where the language or tooling supports it
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Moves range, format and permission defects into type or check time.

common_patterns.name: Dependent Type Boundary
common_patterns.technique: Use proof-carrying values at the highest-risk interfaces
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents consumers from assuming facts that were never established.

common_patterns.name: SMT Constraint Check
common_patterns.technique: Encode conflicting rules as satisfiability constraints
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds inconsistent requirements before implementation spreads them.

common_patterns.name: Abstract Interpretation
common_patterns.technique: Approximate program behavior over safe abstract domains
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Detects classes of runtime errors without executing every path.

common_patterns.name: Separation Logic Ownership
common_patterns.technique: Prove mutable resources have non-overlapping owners
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents aliasing bugs, leaks and hidden shared mutation.

common_patterns.name: Linear Resource Discipline
common_patterns.technique: Use single-use or affine ownership for scarce effects
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops duplicate sends, double frees and repeated irreversible actions.

common_patterns.name: Lock Ordering Protocol
common_patterns.technique: Acquire shared locks in one global order
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents deadlocks during parallel execution.

common_patterns.name: Lease Fencing Token
common_patterns.technique: Every worker mutation carries a monotonic lease token
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents stale workers from overwriting newer authority.

common_patterns.name: Monotonic State Design
common_patterns.technique: Prefer state transitions that only move forward in a lattice
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents rollback races and non-convergent replicas.

common_patterns.name: CRDT Convergence
common_patterns.technique: Use commutative, associative and idempotent merge operations
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets distributed edits converge without central locking.

common_patterns.name: Lattice-Based Merge
common_patterns.technique: Represent partial knowledge with join/meet operations
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents ad hoc conflict resolution from losing information.

common_patterns.name: Deterministic Replay
common_patterns.technique: Persist inputs, time and decisions enough to replay incidents
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Turns intermittent production failures into reproducible traces.

common_patterns.name: Event Sourcing with Projection Tests
common_patterns.technique: Derive current state from an append-only event log
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents silent history loss and makes state reconstruction auditable.

common_patterns.name: Metamorphic Testing
common_patterns.technique: Assert relations between transformed inputs and outputs
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds bugs when no single oracle is available.

common_patterns.name: Differential Testing
common_patterns.technique: Compare independent implementations or versions on the same cases
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds semantic drift across adapters, clients and runtimes.

common_patterns.name: Coverage-Guided Fuzzing
common_patterns.technique: Generate hostile inputs guided by executed paths
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds parser, validation and memory defects missed by examples.

common_patterns.name: Combinatorial Interaction Testing
common_patterns.technique: Cover pairwise or t-wise parameter interactions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces configuration defects without exhaustive test explosion.

common_patterns.name: Symbolic Execution
common_patterns.technique: Explore path conditions instead of concrete examples only
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds branch-specific defects before production traffic finds them.

common_patterns.name: Taint Tracking
common_patterns.technique: Mark untrusted data and verify every sink is protected
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents injection and authorization bypass through hidden data flow.

common_patterns.name: Information Flow Control
common_patterns.technique: Enforce allowed movement between confidentiality and integrity levels
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents sensitive or untrusted data from crossing forbidden boundaries.

common_patterns.name: Capability-Based Authority
common_patterns.technique: Pass explicit unforgeable permissions instead of ambient authority
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents confused-deputy and over-permission defects.

common_patterns.name: Formal Grammar Boundary
common_patterns.technique: Parse external languages with an explicit grammar
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents partial parser acceptance and ambiguous syntax handling.

common_patterns.name: Parser Serializer Round Trip
common_patterns.technique: Parse, serialize and parse again with semantic equality checks
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents lossy transformations and migration corruption.

common_patterns.name: Canonical Intermediate Representation
common_patterns.technique: Normalize equivalent forms before comparison and transformation
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents duplicate identities and representation-dependent behavior.

common_patterns.name: Total Function Interface
common_patterns.technique: Every public function defines behavior for every input class
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents implicit undefined behavior at module boundaries.

common_patterns.name: Option and Result Types
common_patterns.technique: Represent absence and failure explicitly
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents null dereferences and swallowed errors.

common_patterns.name: Resource Scope Guard
common_patterns.technique: Bind acquisition and release to lexical or transaction scope
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents leaks after exceptions and early returns.

common_patterns.name: Compatibility Matrix
common_patterns.technique: Track supported producer/consumer and schema version pairs
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents accidental deployment of incompatible components.

common_patterns.name: Ontology Registry
common_patterns.technique: Centralize domain vocabulary, ownership and canonical meanings
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents duplicate concepts with different operational semantics.

common_patterns.name: Trace Context Propagation
common_patterns.technique: Carry correlation context through every async and remote boundary
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents orphaned logs and untraceable workflow failures.

common_patterns.name: SLO Error Budget Gate
common_patterns.technique: Use service objectives to decide release and rollback policy
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents local feature progress from consuming reliability silently.

common_patterns.name: Chaos Experiment
common_patterns.technique: Inject controlled dependency, latency and infrastructure faults
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds resilience gaps before real incidents compound them.

common_patterns.name: Kill Switch
common_patterns.technique: Every risky external effect has a fast disable path
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents prolonged damage from a bad deployment or dependency change.

common_patterns.name: Shadow Traffic Verification
common_patterns.technique: Run new behavior beside old behavior before user-visible cutover
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds semantic differences without exposing clients.

common_patterns.name: Canary Invariant Monitor
common_patterns.technique: Bind rollout progression to live invariant checks
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents a canary from advancing after hidden correctness drift.

common_patterns.name: Verdict Carries Its Subject
common_patterns.technique: A recorded judgement stores what it examined, not only what it concluded
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops two different acts of judgement from collapsing into one indistinguishable record, so a narrow verdict cannot be read as a broad one.

common_patterns.name: Criterion Is Not The Concept
common_patterns.technique: An operational test stands for a concept only over the class of bearers it was calibrated on
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops a criterion that is co-extensional with a concept for one kind of subject from being applied to every kind, where it silently changes the truth value.

common_patterns.name: Retrieval Is Local, Judgment Is Subscribed
common_patterns.technique: Local zero-dependency embedding, customer-subscribed LLM judgment
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents basic product search and retrieval from failing when AI vendor accounts lapse or rate-limit.

common_patterns.name: A Guard Must Be Reachable From Its Own Defect
common_patterns.technique: Trace defect input forward to verify it reaches the check
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents unreachable guards that sit adjacent to the defect on bypassed branches.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Single owner for every mutable surface
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Every shared file, contract, enum, migration lane and generated artifact has one owner.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Contract before implementation
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: API, event, schema and RAG contracts are reviewed before parallel implementation starts.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Generated files are read-only
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Change the generator or source data, then regenerate.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Append-only by default
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Prefer new extension files or registry rows over edits to shared central files.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Small vertical PRs
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: One PR covers one behavior slice, not feature plus refactor plus formatting.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Merge queue over direct merge
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Every PR is rebuilt on current main before landing.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Serialized migrations
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Database migrations, shared enums and global schemas pass through a single ordered lane.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Refactor freeze lane
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Broad moves, renames and formatting run in their own window.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Conflict forecast
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Task and PR describe touched paths, owners, contracts and expected integration points.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Semantic conflict checks
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: After merge, affected contract, schema and smoke tests must run.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Feature flag isolation
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Incomplete parallel work cannot affect shared runtime without a flag.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Evidence after conflict resolution
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Manual conflict fixes require targeted tests or contract checks.

philosophers.role_application: Код — это язык команды, а не просто инструкция машине. Агент проверяет, что код читается одинаково всеми участниками системы: имена функций, переменных и модулей передают намерение, а не только механику
philosophers.focus: Качество кода, стандарты написания, обязательный Code Review всех PR, архитектурные паттерны на уровне реализации, онбординг новых агентов в кодовую базу

## RAG Instruction

When a task belongs to `BARCAN-TAG-03_BELIEF-INTENSION` and needs the individual voice of Сюзан Hurley, retrieve this file after the common ACP file. Use these 20 patterns as a focused review lens, then attach concrete code evidence before approving work.

philosophers.role_application: Обоснование дизайн-решения обязано пройти уровень вмешательства ($do(x)$), а не только уровень ассоциации: «пользователи чаще нажимают на зелёную кнопку» — это корреляция; «изменение цвета на зелёный увеличивает конверсию» — проверяемое причинное утверждение. Намерение (intention) агента валидно только когда прослежен реальный механизм, а не совпадение по времени
philosophers.focus: Проектирование UI/UX, макеты в Figma, дизайн-системы, визуальная эргономика, причинная глубина намерения (BDI, do-calculus)

## RAG Instruction

When a task belongs to `BARCAN-TAG-04_MODAL-QUANTIFIER` and needs the individual voice of Питер Гэрденфорс, retrieve this file after the common ACP file. Use these 20 patterns as a focused review lens, then attach concrete code evidence before approving work.

philosophers.role_application: Несколько независимых сигналов (holdout-метрика, детектор дрейфа, результат A/B), согласно подтверждающих одно заключение, не считаются «более верными» просто по количеству — уверенность объединяется через log-odds с калибруемой надёжностью каждого источника (`EvidenceCoherenceService.sourceReliability`/`computeConfidences`), не наивным счётом голосов

## RAG Instruction

When a task belongs to `BARCAN-TAG-10_DEONTIC-PROHIBITION` and needs the individual voice of Рональд Дворкин, retrieve this file after the common ACP file. Use these 20 patterns as a focused review lens, then attach concrete code evidence before approving work.

## RAG Instruction

When a task belongs to `BARCAN-TAG-12_SOCIAL-CONTRACT` and needs the individual voice of Дэвид Льюис, retrieve this file after the common ACP file. Use these 20 patterns as a focused review lens, then attach concrete code evidence before approving work.

philosophers.principle: Плановая теория права: разделяемый план как обязывающее правило (shared plan as binding rule)
philosophers.role_application: Контракт — не просто описание API, а «конституция» фичи уровня разделяемого плана: он не предсказывает поведение сторон, а нормативно требует его. Отклонение от контракта — не «другое решение», а нарушение правила, которое обе стороны признали
philosophers.focus: Фиксация общего контракта (эндпоинты, DTO, схема запрос-ответ) между backend и frontend ДО того, как они расходятся на параллельную реализацию
